title: Review the ERD as an authored architectural explanation
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga using the PDF inventory fixture: implemented PDF report held by Record store, proposed JSON PDF job held by Job queue, report-to-job production relationship, application ERD, and pdf-jobs overlay; the reporting ERD also includes a job association with owner 0..many and destination unknown.
Reviewer has the intended application architecture and source model available; the ERD intentionally omits low-level payload properties and database columns.

steps.action: Read the overview and inspect the author-selected entities, layout and relationship explanations.
steps.expected_result: The diagram communicates the application shape and permits deliberate omissions; it is not an exhaustive schema dump.

steps.action: Compare the declared field list with source and inspect the report for omitted fields.
steps.expected_result: Only architecturally meaningful fields and keys need appear; omission alone is not labeled missing implementation.
